description: Stateful quake subscriptions. Unlike a local tool, the filter and its cursor are stored on the server, so poll returns ONLY events newer than your last poll - no re-scanning, no client-side dedupe. Actions: create (min_magnitude, place), poll (id), list, delete (id).

action.description: create a subscription, poll it, list yours, or delete one.

owner.description: Optional namespace to group subscriptions. Default 'public'.

place.description: Substring place filter for create, e.g. 'Japan'.

since_hours.description: On create, seed the cursor this many hours back so the very first poll can return existing events. Default 0 (only new events).

name: watch
